fields.label: Artifact
fields.description: Exact private storage artifact identity whose metadata is read without loading its content.

fields.label: Retention decision
fields.description: Human-owned decision about whether the organization is keeping this artifact.

fields.label: Subject-area key
fields.description: Optional private policy subject key used only to select an exact registered home; omission uses the registered provisional inbox.

fields.label: Placement basis
fields.description: Private factual basis for the subject-area judgment or for declaring that no defensible home is known.

fields.label: Alternative subjects
fields.description: Optional private alternatives surfaced for review and validated against the current registered location set.

fields.label: Frozen snapshot required
fields.description: Whether a frozen copy is explicitly required instead of the normal externally owned shortcut form.

fields.label: Document owner
fields.description: Optional authenticated current workspace user; omission remains a visible required-human gap.

fields.label: Related organization
fields.description: Optional exact organization resource that must resolve through the configured CRM instance.

fields.label: Document type
fields.description: Private requested document classification retained only when it exactly matches the current document-index schema.

fields.label: Index description
fields.description: Private factual one-line explanation of what the artifact is and why it is retained.

fields.label: Skip index requested
fields.description: Records pressure to omit the required index so the request can be surfaced rather than silently obeyed.
